title: LETTER 10: Letter to Editor — Importance of Jan Dhan Accounts

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a national mission aiming to provide universal access to banking services.
Jan Dhan accounts offer zero-balance account opening, direct benefit transfers (DBT), and built-in accident insurance cover through RuPay cards.
A Letter to the Editor regarding Jan Dhan accounts highlights the socio-economic empowerment of marginalized communities through financial inclusion.
Key elements of a formal Letter to the Editor include Sender's Address, Date, Receiver's Address, Subject Line, Formal Salutation, Structured Body, and Sign-off.

blocks.content: Jan Dhan accounts serve as a vital gateway for financial inclusion, bridging the gap between unbanked citizens and formal banking services.

rows: Inbuilt RuPay debit card accidental cover
Optional or dependent on card tier
Available up to ₹10,000 for eligible holders

items: Ensure proper formal letter format: Keep the subject line concise and relevant to the importance of Jan Dhan accounts.
Highlight specific benefits in the body paragraphs, such as Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), overdraft facilities, and financial security for low-income households.
End the letter with a strong call to action urging authorities and citizens to expand financial literacy alongside account opening.
